# Naidong Ma / 马乃东

> Bilingual professional website for Naidong (Michael) Ma, Senior Partner at Dacheng Law Offices, Shanghai. The site covers family and matrimonial disputes, succession and corporate-control disputes, private wealth planning, cross-border legal coordination, professional recognition and publications.

## Important context

- The practice pages describe anonymised prior experience. Prior experience does not guarantee the outcome of any other matter.
- Website materials are for professional exchange and do not constitute legal advice on any specific matter.
- Rankings and professional recognition should be checked against the linked publisher or official firm profile when current status matters.
